timing_scope: Complete public planner wall time, excluding evaluation and one-time native compilation. Thread and worker counts differ by method and are documented in its README. Concurrent development load, process startup, wall-time stopping and one recorded trial per task preclude controlled performance or statistical success-rate claims.
liom_refinement_timing_note: The October 10 LIOM rerun includes an idempotent shared setup-path fix. Other 39 methods retain their previous measurements; no controlled cross-method speed ranking is implied.
